answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging a non-refundable identity bond that only pays out after a long attestation window. Each new agent must file a registry note with a distinctive quill signature and lock tokens until the window closes. If a cluster of accounts shows coordinated voting at the nadir of participation, the bonds are slashed together and the cluster is barred from later epochs. A bitter yarrow flag in the public log marks the burned identities so honest graders can skip them.
